ticker_news.title: Is C3.ai a Top AI Stock to Buy on the Dip?
ticker_news.description: C3.ai, an AI software company, has seen its stock price drop significantly from its all-time highs. While the company's revenue is growing, it is struggling to become profitable due to excessive stock-based compensation and huge losses. The author believes investors should look for a different AI stock to invest in.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

QQQ.title: PayPal Stock: Too Cheap to Ignore, Too Strong to Miss
QQQ.description: PayPal is a cash flow powerhouse, generating $6.8 billion in free cash flow in 2024. Despite a bearish market, the company raised its forward guidance for 2025 and has a strong valuation with a P/E ratio of 14.58 and a forward P/E of 11.6.
QQQ.author: Marketbeat.Com
